messages.subject: R914 resource-discrimination report complete
messages.body: I wrote the bounded decision-support report at bench/results/2026-10-15-pr6-recovery-audit/research-round914-v1.txt (SHA-256 a7078f48ac66bf107c99e6f9690e64d18003031030b8619a38b5d6fef30f9675).
